angles.title: Minerals and geology
angles.question: Which minerals occur where, with what dated reserve/resource classifications?
angles.publisher_targets: IBM National Mineral Inventory, GSI, Directorate of Mines and Geology
angles.interpretation_rule: Stock estimates are not annual output or economically recoverable reserves.

angles.title: Production and national position
angles.question: How have coal, iron ore, bauxite, chromite, manganese and other minerals changed over five and ten years?
angles.publisher_targets: IBM, Coal Controller, Odisha production/despatch returns
angles.interpretation_rule: Match units, grade, coverage and revision vintage; retain falls and interruptions.

angles.title: Processing and manufacturing
angles.question: How much ore is beneficiated, refined or made into metal and finished products inside Odisha?
angles.publisher_targets: Plant annual reports, Ministry of Steel, NALCO, OMC, company disclosures
angles.interpretation_rule: Mine output, refinery output, metal production and installed capacity cannot be added.

angles.title: Revenue and public finances
angles.question: What do royalties, auction premiums and other receipts contribute, and how volatile are they?
angles.publisher_targets: Odisha Finance Accounts, budgets, Directorate revenue returns, CAG
angles.interpretation_rule: Separate actual receipts, revised estimates and budgets; do not label all mining receipts royalty.

angles.title: Mining-area development
angles.question: What do DMF projects deliver in health, water, schooling and livelihoods?
angles.publisher_targets: District DMF accounts, completion records, CAG, district outcome data
angles.interpretation_rule: Collection, sanction, transfer, expenditure, completion and functioning service are distinct.

angles.title: Jobs, skills and small businesses
angles.question: Who works in mines, plants, transport and supplier firms, under what employment conditions?
angles.publisher_targets: DGMS, labour statistics, enterprise reports, procurement disclosures
angles.interpretation_rule: Direct workers, contractors, indirect jobs and promised jobs need separate denominators.

angles.title: Trade and transport
angles.question: Where do minerals and metals go through railways, ports and domestic supply chains?
angles.publisher_targets: Railway freight records, port cargo reports, DGCIS/state-origin exports
angles.interpretation_rule: Cargo handled in an Odisha port is not necessarily produced in Odisha.

angles.title: Land, rights and communities
angles.question: How do acquisition, resettlement, consent, forest rights and local livelihoods affect mining communities?
angles.publisher_targets: Gram Sabha records, district orders, primary judgments and community scholarship
angles.interpretation_rule: Attribute contested claims and decisions; no invented consultations or blanket community views.

angles.title: Air, water, forests and health
angles.question: What do site monitoring records show about dust, water, waste, forests and exposure?
angles.publisher_targets: OSPCB/CPCB, PARIVESH clearances, compliance reports, peer-reviewed measurements
angles.interpretation_rule: Ambient concentrations and health outcomes require location, time and causal caution.

angles.title: Safety and mine closure
angles.question: What happens during operation, closure and restoration, and what liabilities remain?
angles.publisher_targets: DGMS, IBM inspections, approved closure plans and financial assurance records
angles.interpretation_rule: Approval or plantation area alone does not prove safety or ecological recovery.

angles.title: Ownership and accountability
angles.question: Who owns and operates each lease; what is its current stage and compliance history?
angles.publisher_targets: Lease/auction registers, IBM, CAG, court decisions
angles.interpretation_rule: Auction winner, leaseholder, operator and corporate group are different identities.

angles.title: Industrial history and future materials
angles.question: How did mining towns develop, and what could recycling, research and critical minerals change?
angles.publisher_targets: Archives, institutional histories, CSIR-IMMT, IREL and project outcome records
angles.interpretation_rule: Preserve established production versus experiments, proposals and future scenarios.
